notes: Denby's entire website (denbypottery.com) has ceased operating as a storefront. Verified via HTTP fetch (curl with browser UA, since a bare UA returns 403) that all candidate New Arrivals URLs (/collections/new-arrivals, /new-in, /new-products, /just-in, /latest-arrivals, /whats-new) return HTTP 200 but an empty SSR shell (no title, no product markup). Rendered each with a real browser (Playwright driving installed Chrome, domcontentloaded + 4s settle) to see post-JS content, then cross-checked against the site's own homepage, the /collections index, an arbitrary /pages/ URL, and a collection URL verified working in the prior Home-Decor pass (/collections/dinner-plates, /collections/coasters) - every single one, with zero exceptions, renders to the identical 1118-character page: a legal notice stating Joint Administrators were appointed over Denby Group Limited and its subsidiaries (incl. Denby Retail Limited) on 31 March 2026, that Denby Retail Limited operated this site until 4 June 2026, and that operation transferred to Denby Home Pottery Limited on 4 June 2026. The rendered page has 0 links, 0 nav, 0 product grid - only this notice text. Only /sitemap.xml still serves raw XML outside the SPA shell (not useful - it's a static index, not proof of a live catalogue). Conclusion: there is no navigable storefront at all right now, so no New Arrivals PLP (or any PLP) can exist to find, and no 'is this a real listing vs a marketing Collection page' judgment call was even reachable. This is a genuine, verified absence caused by the company's insolvency/administration, not a missed search - checked main nav (none rendered), collections index, sitemap, and every plausible New Arrivals URL shape.
